title: detail+verifier model comparison + free filters

current.label: Gemini Flash V1 detail (prod baseline)
current.notes: Sempre confirma — TP recall 100 mas FP rate também 100 (22/22 REJ passam)

sonnet_detail_V1_V3.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6 detail (V1 cam_10 + V3 cam_11)

pro_detail_V1_V3.label: Gemini Pro 2.5 detail (V1 cam_10 + V3 cam_11)
pro_detail_V1_V3.notes: Acc 51.92%; PIOR detail testado; perde 11 ocorrências reais

agent3_pro_few_shot.label: Gemini Pro 2.5 Agent-3 verifier + 3 few-shot REJ

agent3_sonnet_few_shot.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6 Agent-3 verifier + few-shot REJ
agent3_sonnet_few_shot.notes: Acc 75%; 0 false-confirm mas 2 false-reject; pior+caro que Pro

agent3_flashlite_few_shot.label: Gemini Flash Lite Agent-3 + few-shot REJ

dinov2_per_camera_10.label: DINOv2-base + LogReg per-camera (cam_10 only)
dinov2_per_camera_10.notes: Acc 96%, AUC 0.933 — free filter VENCEDOR pra cam_10

dinov2_per_camera_11.label: DINOv2-base + LogReg per-camera (cam_11 only)
dinov2_per_camera_11.notes: Acc 47%, AUC 0.525 — não funciona em cam_11 (imagem estática insuficiente)

pile_delta_logreg.label: Pile-zone edge delta (OpenCV) + LogReg 14 features
pile_delta_logreg.notes: Acc 67.5% cap, AUC 0.708; fail — gate já pre-seleciona pile-zone activity

bytetrack_yolov8s_cam11.label: ByteTrack + YOLOv8s + dwell features (cam_11 only)
bytetrack_yolov8s_cam11.notes: Acc 60% (=baseline trivial sempre-CON); YOLO COCO não detecta depositadores reais

success_criteria_check.detail_acc_min_70: FAIL — nenhum detail bate 70%; Sonnet 55.8% e Pro 51.9% pioraram
success_criteria_check.verifier_acc_min_80: PASS — Pro 87.5% sobre 8 events (limitação: amostra pequena)
success_criteria_check.cost_per_event_max_0.020: PASS pra Pro verifier ($0.015), FAIL pra Sonnet/Pro detail

verdict: Recomenda manter Flash V1/V3 como Agent-2; adicionar DINOv2+LogReg shadow A/B para cam_10 ($0, 96%); Pro 2.5 + few-shot REJ como Agent-3 só para cam_11 ($0.015/event, 87.5%). Sonnet 4.6, Pro como detail, Flash Lite Agent-3, pile-delta hard filter e ByteTrack-COCO: descartados.
